exposure: Prophylactic phenylephrine weight adjusted dose infusion (0.5 micrograms per kilogram per minute)
Prophylactic phenylephrine fixed dose infusion (37.5 micrograms per minute)
outcome: Number of times the infusion was stopped
cohort: 108 women undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: The incidence of hypotension was significantly lower in the weight-adjusted dose group compared to the fixed-dose group.
